xmldoc.short_description: Object that stores a row filter expression.

param_input_item.param_description: variable names specified as a string array or cell array of character vectors.

param_output_item.param_description: a nelson.io.RowFilter object containing a filter expression.

description.p: nelson.io.RowFilter stores the variable names and expression used to select rows.

Variable names are accessed with dot notation. Relational and logical operators create a filter expression. The expression is evaluated when apply is called or when the object is used as a RowFilter argument for Parquet reading functions.
The variables method returns the names referenced by the expression.
